Q5786.reason: Post-accident refusal of care is a mitigation/avoidable-consequences issue, so the estate recovers only the wound and suffering up to the refusal, not wrongful-death damages, and it is not contributory negligence.

Q5086.reason: Anaerobic metabolism means ATP generation by pathways that do not use oxygen, and those pathways can run even when oxygen is available.

Q5171.reason: Once a unit leaves refrigeration the transfusion should be started within 30 minutes; the four-hour limit is for completing the transfusion.
